summary: MarketWise, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 7, 2026, reporting Q1 2026 results and reauthorizing a $50 million stock repurchase program for its Class A common stock over 12 months. Repurchases may occur via open market or other transactions under Rule 10b-18, with timing depending on market conditions; no obligation to repurchase any specific amount. Each repurchase triggers redemption of an equivalent common unit in MarketWise, LLC, reducing the Company's ownership percentage. Additionally, the Board declared $0.45 per share in dividends. Watch execution pace and potential ownership dilution effects.
